failure_policy: Retain every completed legal normal result and played-move time forfeit. Abandoned/native/illegal/unterminated result, zero-move/incomplete PGN, nonzero referee exit, timeout or any input/qualification mismatch invalidates the full experiment; preserve all raw evidence and stop the failed shard. Other shard may finish its fixed list (fail-fast false). No pair replay or repair-run is authorized by this plan.
fixed_sample_policy: Exactly all286 pairs once, across both disjoint143-pair shards. No seed or model selection, no statistical or outcome stopping, no extra games, no outcome-based retries or omitted completed results.
native_qualification: On each host before games: verify exact archive/executable/net SHA and sizes, two fresh configured-default51 UCI benches per arm matching the pinned per-side search signature, and startpos perft4=197281. No laptop engines/builds.

opening_order.first_color: Candidate first iff integer SHA256(color_domain+root_id) modulo2 equals0; second game reverses colors.
opening_order.ordering: Ascending SHA256(order_domain+root_id), once per unique family; shard=global pair_index modulo2.

outcome_access: No partial scores or partial game results will be inspected. Open scoring artifacts only after both shards reach terminal state.

runtime.evalfile: Explicit pinned EvalFile on both arms; candidate must use the released d5 external file rather than its compiled original18cd default.

scientific_scope: Whole released history/prefetch-plus-d5 bundle versus actual official Nov9 Windows universal engine. Any observed differential belongs to the complete bundles and must not be attributed solely to weights.

statistics.boundary_policy: If a percentile is0 or1, logistic Elo is null with explicit negative_infinity/positive_infinity boundary label.
host_by_shard_outputs: actual runner identity and load/configuration receipts
primary_outputs: score fraction and descriptive logistic Elo
statistics.scope: Descriptive for this complete known retired public development population and these two hosted VMs; no fresh confirmation, private alpha, SPRT or gain claim.
statistics.uncertainty: Exact integer empirical paired-bootstrap percentile,286 iid empirical pair draws, nominal central95%, smallest k with40*CDF(k)>=q*286^286 forq=1,39; no interpolation.
